content: Spec-driven landscape: Spec Kit 1.0 (specify init/check, /speckit.constitution|specify|clarify|plan|tasks|analyze|checklist|implement|converge|taskstoissues, specs/NNN/spec.md plan.md tasks.md, 30+ agents, bundles/extensions incl bug-fix flow; no EARS/Gherkin). OpenSpec (openspec init/update/config; /opsx:explore|propose|apply|archive|verify; openspec/specs + changes/<name>/proposal.md design.md tasks.md specs delta with ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED; requirement SHALL + '#### Scenario:' WHEN/THEN). BMAD v6 (npx bmad-method install, 12+ role agents, clarify/plan/build-verify loop). Kiro (requirements.md EARS or bugfix.md, design.md, tasks.md, approval gates between phases, dependency-wave tasks, hooks/steering, IDE lock-in). Backlog.md (markdown tasks with AC checkboxes, project DoD via config, board/browser web UI, MCP server, AGENTS.md injection, review checkpoints). Decap CMS editorial_workflow: branch cms/<collection>/<slug> + PR per entry, draft/in-review/ready, publish merges, squash_merges. 2026 entrants: Tessl, specs.md (AI-DLC), GSD.
